novelty_delta: Twenty-sixth behaviour, and a generality test across PAIRS rather than across classes. correlative_state established that `either` obliges `or`; this is a different correlative with a different second element -- `both` obliges `and`, `neither` obliges `nor` -- and a disjoint answer vocabulary. It also differs in what the first element does: `either` and `neither` both open a two-way choice, whereas `both` and `neither` differ in POLARITY over a conjunction, so the model must carry a positive-versus-negative distinction rather than pick between two disjuncts. Recipient and donor differ only in the correlative word and end on the same noun token; A2 uses a second matrix verb.
